id./param/scenario/cs/b_160_cs_050.pack|cs_: "So you've come... heir to the Luminary's name...

"The World Tree that created all is dead.
  Now I am king of Erdrea...

"With the Tree's soul, the source of life,
  you are but a leaf to be blown away.
"Those eyes... They recall the Luminaries of old.

"Love, hope, dreams...
  Humans cling to foolish illusions
  and struggle on stubbornly!

"I, king of all the world,
  will carve into your corpses
  a despair that never fades!
